Key repos include 'anthropics/claude-code' (3,048 stars this week), an agentic coding tool for terminal workflows; 'chopratejas/headroom' (3,002 stars), which provides an MCP server for token-efficient LLM communication; 'microsoft/agent-governance-toolkit' (1,391 stars), offering essential security and reliability for autonomous agents; and 'mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills' (3,755 stars), which maps cybersecurity skills for AI agents across major frameworks.

In the Rust ecosystem, momentum is driven by high-performance dev-tooling and agent infrastructure. Notable repos include 'farion1231/cc-switch' (7,667 stars this week), a cross-platform assistant for various coding agents; 'run-llama/liteparse' (3,699 stars), a high-performance document parser for RAG pipelines; 'dmtrKovalenko/fff' (1,228 stars), a fast file search toolkit optimized for AI agents; and 'ogulcancelik/herdr' (1,327 stars), an agent multiplexer designed for terminal-based agent management.

one fallback above.

    "findings": "<2–6 short paragraphs of normalised text>"
